summary: 8x Worker MVP fully validated end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/missions (3 items with correct types & isExtra flag), GET /api/missions/{id} (full detail + 404), GET /api/profile (5 dimensions, process>outcome invariant, no _id leak), GET /api/history (3 items), and POST /api/submissions for both text and voice — both return {ok:true, message:'Got it — thank you.'} and evolve observedMissions (+1). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, Expo web preview): Welcome → name entry → Missions inbox with all 3 mission cards including the 'EXTRA' badge → text mission (m_extra_text) fills q1+q2, submits, success screen 'Got it — thank you.' shown, auto-advances to Profile → all 5 capability bars render (domain_intuition, problem_solving, communication, reliability, adaptability) with Process (larger) + Outcome split and 'Observed from N completed missions' indicator that evolves live → History tab renders 3 completed entries → Bottom tab navigation between Missions/Profile/History works → Voice mission (m_chef_voice): ready-to-start → consent-toggle + consent-continue → voice screen shows RECORDING badge, LISTENING state, dosa scenario, voice-waveform, voice-timer counting up (00:01 → 00:04), voice-pause-button toggles, voice-finish-button submits and routes to success → profile. Real mic is simulated on web as documented. No red screens, no page errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking but should be migrated for future RN versions. Origin likely in one of react-native-reanimated / gesture-handler / gorhom bottom-sheet usage inside ConsentSheet or animated backdrops.

action_items: (Optional) Track down the source of the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning and switch to style.pointerEvents once the underlying library exposes it — currently emitted repeatedly from a third-party animated wrapper.

(Nice-to-have) The bottom tab bar renders one accessible <button> per tab; earlier automation runs saw a duplicate tab-history testID in one snapshot but couldn't reproduce it — worth a quick audit of BottomTabBar to ensure only one element carries each testID.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id from /api/profile (get_profile_state pops _id). Good.
evolve_profile enforces process > outcome invariant via `min(outcome+1, process-4)` — correct and matches the frontend visualisation contract.
Frontend api/client.ts falls back to local mock data on any network failure — good demo resilience.
voice/[id].tsx correctly gates real mic access behind Platform.OS !== 'web' so the web preview simulation works as documented.
All interactive components carry kebab-case testIDs matching the review request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (welcome, missions inbox, text mission submit, profile evolution, history, tab nav, voice mission full flow)

seed_data_creation: No manual seed created. Backend uses mock_data.MISSIONS/BASE_PROFILE/HISTORY. Test submissions used TEST_-prefixed answers on m_extra_text and m_chef_voice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile observedMissions is persisted in Mongo (db.profile_state doc _id='default') and increments monotonically as submissions are POSTed. Any regression run will see a higher baseline than 3. To reset for a clean demo, run: mongosh test_database --eval 'db.profile_state.deleteMany({})' (or drop db.submissions too). Voice flow on web is simulated — no real mic capture, but timer/waveform/state machine all run. Bottom tab items sometimes surface two elements to Playwright's locator (screen reader button + visual); use `.locator('[data-testid=...]').last` to click the visible one.
rca_of_issue: Not applicable — no bugs found. The one automation false-negative during the first pass ('no success after voice finish') was a test-timing artifact: success.tsx auto-advances to /profile after 3200ms, so a 4s wait after clicking voice-finish lands on /profile instead of the success screen. Direct verification confirmed the submission fires (observedMissions incremented) and the router replaces to /success → /profile as designed.
